title: Compound interest calculator
description: Projects the growth of an investment with an initial capital and periodic contributions: final value, total contributed, interest earned, real value after inflation and a year-by-year series. Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

compounding.description: How often interest compounds, independent of the contribution frequency (default annual). With annual, annualRate is the effective annual return; with any other value, it is a nominal annual rate (TIN) compounded that many times a year.

inflationRate.description: Estimated annual inflation, for the real value.

title: Simple interest calculator
description: Interest on a principal at simple interest (not reinvested), gross and net of the Spanish withholding tax on investment income (rendimientos del capital mobiliario). Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

annualRate.description: Annual interest rate (TIN, nominal annual rate).

title: Average share price (weighted average cost)
description: Weighted average price of several purchases of the same security (fees included) and, if the current price is given, the position's value and gain/loss. Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

price.description: Price per share of the purchase.

title: Dividend calculator
description: Dividend income gross and net of withholding tax, dividend yield and a projection with dividend growth. Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

sharePrice.description: Price per share, for the dividend yield.

title: ROI calculator
description: Return on a closed investment: ROI gross and net of costs and taxes and, given the years, the annualised return (CAGR). Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

income.description: Income received during the investment (dividends, coupons…).

title: Staking calculator (crypto)
description: Return on staking crypto-assets at a compounded APY, gross and net of the tax on the rewards. Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

title: Financial independence calculator (FIRE)
description: FIRE number (annual spending / withdrawal rate) and years to reach it with the given savings and REAL return, with a year-by-year series. For the probability of success with volatility, use the `simulador-montecarlo` calculator; to measure the user's real portfolio against the goal, `get_fire_goal_progress`. Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

savings.description: Savings per period until reaching FIRE.

title: FIRE Monte Carlo simulator
description: Simulates thousands of lifetimes with random returns (lognormal) or by resampling US history since 1871 (Shiller) and returns the probability of reaching FIRE and of the money lasting through retirement, the years to FIRE at the 10th/50th/90th percentiles and the wealth path by percentile. The same seed gives a reproducible result. Optionally, a sensitivity table for the withdrawal rate. Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

retirementYears.description: Years the portfolio must sustain spending once retired.

historicalStockShare.description: If given, uses historical returns with this % in stocks (the rest in bonds) instead of the lognormal model; annualReturn and volatility are ignored.

includeSensitivity.description: Adds the probability of success for withdrawal rates from 3% to 5%.

title: Retirement savings calculator
description: Estimated wealth at retirement age with the given monthly savings, in nominal and real terms, with a year-by-year series. Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

title: Monthly budget (50/30/20 rule)
description: Splits net monthly income into needs, wants and savings and compares them with the 50/30/20 rule. Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

needs.description: Monthly spending on needs (housing, food, utilities…).

title: Fixed-rate mortgage
description: Monthly payment (French amortisation system), total interest, TAE (annual equivalent rate) including the opening fee and bundled products (vinculaciones), and a yearly amortisation schedule. Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

openingFeeRate.description: Opening fee (comisión de apertura), % of the principal.

annualInsurance.description: Annual cost of the bundled products (vinculaciones).

title: What mortgage can I afford?
description: Maximum affordable home price and mortgage given income, debts, savings and debt-to-income ratio (ratio de esfuerzo), stating which limit binds (monthly payment or down payment). Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

downPayment.description: Savings available for the down payment and purchase costs.

effortRatio.description: Maximum debt-to-income ratio (ratio de esfuerzo, default 35%).

maxLtv.description: Maximum % of the price the bank finances (loan-to-value, default 80%).

title: Buying with a mortgage vs renting
description: Compares the net worth of buying with a mortgage against renting and investing the difference over the given horizon, with a year-by-year series. Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

annualCostRate.description: Annual ownership costs, % of the price (IBI property tax, community fees…).

investmentReturn.description: Annual return on investing the spare capital.

sellingCostsRate.description: Selling costs at the end, % of the value.

title: Early mortgage repayment
description: Compares an early repayment that lowers the monthly payment with one that shortens the term: new payment, term, interest saved and net saving after the early repayment fee (comisión de amortización). Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

compensationRate.description: Early repayment fee (comisión por amortización), % of the amount repaid.

title: Rental yield
description: Gross and net yield of a long-term rental property, accounting for vacancies, IBI (property tax), community fees, insurance and maintenance. Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

vacancyRate.description: Non-payment or vacant months, % of the year (default 5%).

title: Holiday rental yield
description: Income, costs and net yield of a holiday rental given the nightly rate, occupancy, fees and cleaning. Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

annualExpenses.description: Fixed annual costs (IBI property tax, community fees, insurance, utilities…).

title: Fixed-term deposit or interest-bearing account
description: Interest on a fixed-term deposit (depósito a plazo fijo) or an interest-bearing account (cuenta remunerada) from its TAE (annual equivalent rate), gross and net of withholding tax, and the final value in today's purchasing power. Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

title: Fixed-term deposit or interest-bearing account
description: Interest on a fixed-term deposit (depósito a plazo fijo) or an interest-bearing account (cuenta remunerada) from its TAE (annual equivalent rate), gross and net of withholding tax, and the final value in today's purchasing power. Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

title: Gross to net salary
description: Estimates the annual and monthly net salary from the gross: Social Security contributions, state and regional IRPF (Spanish income tax), and personal and family allowances (mínimos). Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

payments.description: Number of salary payments per year (12 or 14; default 14).

pensionContribution.description: Annual pension plan contribution (reduces the tax base).

age.description: Taxpayer's age (affects the personal allowance, mínimo personal).

childrenUnder3.description: How many of those children are under 3.

disability.description: Taxpayer's disability grade: none, g33 (≥33%) or g65 (≥65%).

region.description: Autonomous community (comunidad autónoma, common regime). Without a value, the default regional scale (escala autonómica supletoria) applies. The Basque Country, Navarre and Ceuta/Melilla are not supported.

title: IRPF payroll withholding
description: IRPF (Spanish income tax) withholding rate that applies to the payroll and the monthly withholding, with the same model as the net salary. Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

payments.description: Number of salary payments per year (12 or 14; default 14).

pensionContribution.description: Annual pension plan contribution (reduces the tax base).

age.description: Taxpayer's age (affects the personal allowance, mínimo personal).

childrenUnder3.description: How many of those children are under 3.

disability.description: Taxpayer's disability grade: none, g33 (≥33%) or g65 (≥65%).

region.description: Autonomous community (comunidad autónoma, common regime). Without a value, the default regional scale (escala autonómica supletoria) applies. The Basque Country, Navarre and Ceuta/Melilla are not supported.

title: IRPF for the self-employed (autónomos)
description: Annual IRPF (Spanish income tax) of a self-employed worker under direct assessment (estimación directa, normal or simplified) from income, expenses and the self-employed social security fee (cuota de autónomos), with net business income and effective rate. Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

expenses.description: Annual deductible expenses (excluding the self-employed social security fee, cuota de autónomos).

socialSecurity.description: Annual self-employed social security fee (cuota de autónomos).

simplifiedRegime.description: Simplified direct assessment (estimación directa simplificada: 5% for hard-to-justify expenses).

age.description: Taxpayer's age (affects the personal allowance, mínimo personal).

childrenUnder3.description: How many of those children are under 3.

disability.description: Taxpayer's disability grade: none, g33 (≥33%) or g65 (≥65%).

region.description: Autonomous community (comunidad autónoma, common regime). Without a value, the default regional scale (escala autonómica supletoria) applies. The Basque Country, Navarre and Ceuta/Melilla are not supported.

title: Pension plan tax relief
description: IRPF (Spanish income tax) saving from contributing to a pension plan given the gross salary and the autonomous community, applying the legal limits on individual and employer contributions. Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

employerContribution.description: Annual employer contribution to an occupational pension plan (plan de empleo).

region.description: Autonomous community (comunidad autónoma, common regime). Without a value, the default regional scale (escala autonómica supletoria) applies. The Basque Country, Navarre and Ceuta/Melilla are not supported.

title: Gift tax (impuesto de donaciones)
description: Tax due under the Inheritance and Gift Tax (Impuesto sobre Sucesiones y Donaciones, gift) with the state scale, the multiplier for kinship and pre-existing wealth, and the given regional rebate (bonificación autonómica). Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

kinship.description: Kinship group (grupo de parentesco): grupoI_II (descendants, spouse, ascendants), grupoIII (siblings, nephews and nieces, uncles and aunts, in-laws) or grupoIV (everyone else).

regionalRebate.description: Regional rebate (bonificación autonómica) on the tax due.

title: Wealth tax (impuesto sobre el patrimonio)
description: Tax due under the Wealth Tax (Impuesto sobre el Patrimonio) with the state scale, the primary residence exemption, the tax-free allowance (mínimo exento) and the given regional rebate (bonificación autonómica). Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

totalWealth.description: Total net wealth (assets and rights minus debts).

primaryResidenceValue.description: Value of the primary residence (vivienda habitual, exempt up to €300,000).

regionalRebate.description: Regional rebate (bonificación autonómica) on the tax due.

title: Credit card interest
description: Months to pay off a card debt (fixed payment or a percentage of the balance, typical of revolving credit), total interest and the balance at the end of each year. If the payment does not cover the interest, monthsToPayoff is null and so are the totals (the debt is never paid off). Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

paymentMode.description: fixed (fixed payment) or percent (% of the balance, with a floor).

minPercent.description: Minimum payment, % of the balance (percent mode).

minFloor.description: Floor of the minimum payment (percent mode).

title: Inflation and purchasing power
description: What an amount of today is worth in the future with the given inflation and how much purchasing power is lost if the money sits idle or earns little, with a year-by-year series. Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.

nominalReturn.description: Nominal return on the money (0 = idle).

title: Financial health check
description: Scores financial health from 0 to 100 with 8 weighted questions and returns a category (critical, fragile, stable, strong). Each answer is an option from 0 (worst) to 3 (best); missing ones count as 0. Options: emergencyFund (0 none, 1 <1 month of expenses, 2 1–3 months, 3 >3 months); savingsRate (0 none, 1 <10%, 2 10–20%, 3 >20%); debt excluding the mortgage (0 expensive debt, 1 personal/car loan, 2 little and under control, 3 none); housingCost as % of income (0 >50%, 1 35–50%, 2 25–35%, 3 <25%); investing (0 no, 1 getting started, 2 occasionally, 3 regularly and diversified); retirement (0 nothing, 1 public pension only, 2 contributes sometimes, 3 plan with regular contributions); protection (0 no insurance, 1 mandatory only, 2 some key insurance, 3 well covered); tracking (0 does not know, 1 rough idea, 2 checks now and then, 3 monthly budget). Amounts are in the user's currency (the tax calculators, in euros). Percentages are on a base of 100 (5 = 5%). Computation only, without reading user data; it is an indicative estimate, not advice.
